entries.1a604b2eeb0c6966: A general leasing company headquartered in Sapporo City, listed on the Sapporo Securities Exchange. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements; it is a company that reports on a non-consolidated basis and has two subsidiaries: Mednext Co., Ltd. and MC Net Co., Ltd. The number of employees in the 54th fiscal period was 180.
entries.1f5ac469bbc1338e: It has set a medium-term management plan 2026-2028, 'Deepening Toward the Next Stage ~Challenge Creates the Future~', and its strategic core consists of expanding the leasing and installment business beyond vehicles and construction machinery, concentrating management resources on promising areas such as focusing on the Tokyo area, expanding the leasing business domain, strengthening the management foundation that supports the growth of people and organization, and taking on new businesses. Under its basic management policy, it aims for 'sound management,' and intends to improve the soundness of operating assets and strengthen comprehensive risk management.
